from pathlib import Path
# Try a length that includes extra bytes after the address block, stressing the size logic.
sig = bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
for ln in [12, 16, 20, 28, 255]:
    hdr = sig + bytes([0x21, 0x11]) + ln.to_bytes(2, 'big')
    addr = bytes.fromhex('7f0000017f00000130390050')
    body = b'B' * ln
    http = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
    p = Path(f'/workspace/poc_len_{ln}.bin')
    p.write_bytes(hdr + addr + body + http)
print('done')
